Naitik starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards north. He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, turns right and drives 17 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 8 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)1865
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (6 km to the east) है।

questions.question: PNQO is related to USVT in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JHKI is related to OMPN. To which of the given options is MKNL related, following the same logic?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All benches are tables.Some chairs are tables.No chair is a stool.Conclusions:I. Some benches are chairs.II. No stool is a table.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion I nor II follows.) है।

questions.question: Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.33   69   94   110   119   ?

In this question, a statement given is followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of the assumptions is implicit in the statement.Statement:To enhance security, the company has implemented two-factor authentication (2FA) for all user accounts.Assumptions:I. The current security measures were considered insufficient.II. Users may find it challenging to adapt to two-factor authentication.
options: Neither assumption I nor II are implicit.
Both assumptions I and II are implicit.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Only assumption I is implicit.) है।

questions.question: Below are given two sets of numbers. In each set of numbers, a certain mathematical operation on the first number results in the second number. Which of the given options follows the same set of mathematical operations as followed in the two sets?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)16 – 36 – 51 – 7135 – 55 – 70 – 90
